calculator: npm run -s theory -- boxes F / F# / G / A / B / C / C# / D / E (rootFret of the E shape on the low E string: F 1, F♯ 2, G 3, A 5, B 7, C 8; of the A shape on the A string: B 2, C 3, C♯ (D♭) 4, D 5, E 7, G 10)
npm run -s theory -- boxes A minor (the open Am shape x-0-2-2-1-0, moved up for the four-string minor: Bm x x 4 4 3 2 = F♯ B D F♯, as in barre-chord-alternatives)
npm run -s theory -- scale C major (C, F and G are the I, IV and V chords of C, the blues in C; Fmaj7 = F A C E)
npm run -s theory -- scale F major (V7 = C7: C E G B♭; C7 x 3 2 3 1 x = C E B♭ C, the open C7 with the high e left out)
npm run -s theory -- scale G major (V7 = D7: D F♯ A C; D7 x 5 4 5 3 x = D F♯ C D)
npm run -s theory -- scale A major (V7 = E7: E G♯ B D; E7 x 7 6 7 5 x = E G♯ D E)

Chord boxes copied from barre-chord-alternatives and checked by chord-shapes' shapeFromFrets (articles.test.ts): plain F, G, A x x 3 2 1 x / 5 4 3 / 7 6 5; Bm, Cm, C♯m four-string; B7 open (library) and C7 x 3 2 3 1 x; D, E, F♯ and Dm, Em, F♯m from the open D shapes; C9, D9, E9; Fmaj7, Gmaj7, Amaj7 on the low E with fingering 1 x 3 4 2 x
One fret = a half step, two frets = a whole step: boxes F and G (low E 1 and 3), boxes B and C (A string 2 and 3)
